sourceCollectionName.description: {@link SourceCollection} used in the overview panel.

status.description:
State of the latest entry of {@link DataIntegStatus}
for this {@link SourceCollection}.

processRate.description:
Process rate of {@link SourceCollection}
It should be a rolling average of the per-second process rate over the past 10 minutes.
Essentially, sum(each TransformStatus inst successful count) / (10 mins * 60 seconds per min min)
filtered to TransformStatus.meta.updated > now() - 10 mins

skipRate.description:
Skip rate of {@link SourceCollection}
It should be a rolling average of the per-second skip rate over the past 10 minutes.
Essentially, sum(each TransformStatus inst skip count) / (10 mins * 60 seconds per min min)
filtered to TransformStatus.meta.updated > now() - 10 mins

failureRate.description:
Failure rate of {@link SourceCollection}
It should be a rolling average of the per-second failure rate over the past 10 minutes.
Essentially, sum(each TransformStatus inst failed count) / (10 mins * 60 seconds per min min)
filtered to TransformStatus.meta.updated > now() - 10 mins

itemsQueueProcessing.description: Items currently being processed for {@link SourceCollection}

updated.description: Timestamp when Obj was updated in source system.

updatedBy.description: Member id that last updated the instance.

processMode.description: processMode derived from {@link SourceCollection.Config} for {@link SourceCollection}

processSchedule.description: Only valid if processMode is ON_SCHEDULE

title:
A type to fetch and populate the SourceCollectionOverview grid.
It combines data from
{@link SourceCollection}, {@link DataIntegStatus} and {@link SourceCollection.Config}.
name: SourceCollectionOverview
